claims.supported_statement: A scoping review mapped 806 non-English clinical LLM evaluations across 62 languages and found sparse matched English comparisons.

limitations: Most extraction used titles/abstracts; only a 100-study sample received full-text assessment of translation and cultural adaptation.

LINGUA is a proposed instrument requiring prospective validation, not an adopted standard.
